mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average signals strengthening consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 12-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 6-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances during a monetary easing cycle.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 3-month MA & UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) signals a broad-based strengthening of demand, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 6-month MA & RSAFS > 12-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) coupled with a rise in Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals supply-side inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 6-month MA & CPIAUCSL > 2% YoY.
